operatingPrinciple.vision: Deliver a safe, offline-capable HRM RT-PCR analysis workflow with versioned, machine-readable system self-documentation.
constraints: Keep all analysis client-side to preserve data privacy.
Prefer extending the existing static PWA over introducing backend infrastructure.
Do not weaken existing validation, offline support, or export functionality.
operatingPrinciple.accountability: Repository changes must update this document when system behavior, architecture, or operational limits change.

possibleInterpretations: Rebuild the application into a fully autonomous platform with new services and orchestration.
Refactor the existing PWA into multiple new subsystems.
Extend the current PWA with explicit architecture, safety, and execution documentation that is versioned with the codebase.
intentInterpretation.selectedInterpretation: Extend the current PWA with explicit architecture, safety, and execution documentation that is versioned with the codebase.
selectionCriteria: Feasibility within the current static application architecture
Smallest safe change that improves system clarity and governance
functionalRequirements: Document system components, responsibilities, and data flow.
Record execution phases, validation strategy, and safety guardrails.
Track change rationale and known limitations in a machine-readable format.
nonFunctionalRequirements: Preserve data privacy by keeping analysis local to the browser.
Keep the documentation artifact stable enough for automated validation.

autonomousSystemDesign.reason: The repository already contains a cohesive, modular PWA. Extending it is safer than a rebuild and preserves working analysis behavior.

components.name: App Shell
components.responsibility: Coordinates UI state, events, and module initialization.

components.name: File Handler
components.responsibility: Validates inputs and loads CSV or EDS files.

components.name: Data Processor
components.responsibility: Normalizes melt curves, calculates derivatives, detects Tm, and prepares analysis outputs.

components.name: Chart Manager
components.responsibility: Builds and updates the chart visualizations.

components.name: Export Manager
components.responsibility: Exports processed data and chart artifacts.

components.name: EDS Parser
components.responsibility: Parses Applied Biosystems .eds archives into analysis-ready data.

components.name: Utilities
components.responsibility: Provides pure numerical helpers, validation helpers, and user feedback utilities.

components.name: Offline Cache
components.responsibility: Caches app resources, including this system artifact, for offline access.

dataFlow: User uploads a CSV or EDS file.
File handler validates the payload and delegates parsing.
Data processor extracts samples and computes normalized, derivative, and difference data.
App shell dispatches analysis events and updates the UI.
Chart manager renders the visualization set.
Export manager produces CSV and PNG artifacts.
apiContracts: No remote API contracts are required because the application is fully client-side.

phases: Phase 1: Preserve core file upload, analysis, charting, and export behavior.
Phase 2: Protect stability with validation and tests.
Phase 3: Improve offline delivery and documentation reliability.
Phase 4: Add enhancements only when they do not compromise scientific correctness or simplicity.
atomicTasks: Keep the architecture map in source control.
Validate that required protocol sections exist.
Cache the artifact for offline inspection.

rules: Prefer correctness over speed for scientific calculations.
Prefer simple module boundaries over framework-heavy abstractions.
Preserve consistency between documentation, tests, and runtime behavior.

checks: Run Vitest unit tests for pure logic and documentation artifact validation.
Keep offline cache entries aligned with static assets.
continuousSelfValidation.failurePolicy: If validation fails, treat the change as incomplete until tests and lint pass again.

signals: Toast notifications for user-facing errors or successes.
Console warnings for incomplete sample coverage or parsing problems.
Versioned service worker cache updates for static assets.
observabilityDrivenAdaptation.adaptationPolicy: Use validation failures, parsing warnings, and cache version changes as triggers for safe iteration.

improvementSources: Scientific workflow gaps identified during analysis
autonomousImprovementLoop.prioritization: Fix correctness and safety issues before performance or UX enhancements.

allowedActions: Extend modules when behavior remains coherent with the current PWA architecture.
Refactor internal structure when it improves clarity or safety.
Document tradeoffs and limitations in this artifact.
decisionAuthorityModel.safetyGate: Do not introduce backend complexity, data loss risk, or new attack surface without clear need.

never: Corrupt uploaded data or silently alter analysis results.
Introduce security-sensitive remote data processing for local scientific files.
Break existing offline, analysis, or export flows without a validated replacement.
always: Use source control as the rollback mechanism.
Version architecture and decision changes with the codebase.
Choose the safest non-destructive path when uncertainty is high.

artifacts.purpose: Machine-readable architecture map, safety contract, and decision log.
Human-readable overview and entry point for contributors.

targets: Lower complexity through small, explicit extensions
Stronger security and privacy through local-only analysis
Improved developer experience through versioned system documentation

terminationCondition.definition: The current scope is complete when the existing PWA behavior remains stable and the system documentation artifact fully describes the active architecture, safety constraints, and validation flow.
terminationCondition.followUpTrigger: Continue iterating when the architecture, workflow, or scientific analysis behavior materially changes.

coreBehavioralHeuristics: Continuously question whether the simplest safe design is still being used.

alternativesRejected: Full rebuild into a multi-service platform because it would add risk and complexity without supporting the current client-side use case.
Broad refactor of working modules because the issue can be solved with a versioned documentation artifact and automated validation.

changeLog.summary: Added a versioned autonomous system artifact, offline caching for the artifact, and tests that validate the required protocol structure.

knownLimitations: The application intentionally has no remote telemetry or background orchestration because uploaded scientific data stays in the browser.
Continuous improvement remains repository-driven rather than runtime self-modifying.
Observability is limited to local UI feedback, console diagnostics, and automated repository validation.
